pass_a_gloss: §13 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Naming the animals; Eve from Adam’s rib.
pass_b_english: Now while Adam was walking in Paradise, God, who was there, brought before him all the animals and ordered him to give a name to each; and Adam imposed a name on each of the living creatures. ([[whatever Adam called … that was its name >> Bible:Gen 2:19-20]])

God also resolved to give a helper to the human being; then he spoke thus: ‘It is not good that the human being should be alone; let us make for him a helper like him.’ ([[Gen 2:18 >> Bible:Gen 2:18]]) For among all the living beings there was no helper equal, proportionate, and like Adam.

Now God himself sent an ecstasy upon Adam and put him to sleep; and for the accomplishment of his masterpiece God willed that Adam should fall into sleep, which previously did not exist in Paradise. God took one of Adam’s ribs and re-formed the flesh in its place; and from that rib which he had drawn out he made the woman; then he set her in Adam’s presence. ([[rib … woman >> Bible:Gen 2:21-22]])
At this sight Adam cried: ‘This now is bone of my bones, flesh of my flesh; she shall be called woman, because she comes from a man who is hers.’ ([[Gen 2:23 >> Bible:Gen 2:23]])
